title: kbmon's cheap GUID scan and fact counts share code with redact and kbfacts instead of copying it
goal: mon_view's public-root GUID scan and mon_kb's audit rows call shared functions of redact and kbfacts (or one shared helper), so a change to either cannot leave kbmon's display redaction or counts behind

run:
import sys,inspect
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_view,mon_kb
c=[n for n,m in (('mon_view',mon_view),('mon_kb',mon_kb)) if 'def scan_guids' in inspect.getsource(m) or 'def audit_rows' in inspect.getsource(m)]
print('modules with their own copy:',c);sys.exit(1 if c else 0)
